frequency_question: What proportion of threatened indefinite industry strikes proceed to initiation within the final week before the deadline?
membership_rule: Includes formalized industry-wide union federation strike notices or ultimatums with a hard deadline; excludes localized single-employer disputes or wildcat strikes.
window: Five-day final countdown window leading up to the stated strike date
coverage_note: 6 named representative comparable labor dispute escalation cycles; estimated universe of ~30 globally in comparable large-scale economy sectors over past decade.
known_gaps: Varying legal frameworks across different national jurisdictions regarding mandatory cooling-off periods.
validity_reason: Labor negotiation dynamics and conciliation structures remain stable across medium-term economic cycles.
